display_name: Mini-LED QLED (Samsung QN90D / Hisense U8N tier)
short_description: Mini-LED LCD with 2,024 nits peak HDR and 689 nits full-screen — the brightest panel type for HDR specular highlights. Zone-based local dimming means imperfect blacks.

default_display_optics.contrast_notes: Zone-based local dimming — contrast figure is approximate and depends on zone count and content. Halos visible around bright objects on dark backgrounds.

known_limitations: Zone-based local dimming produces halos around bright objects on dark backgrounds — does not achieve OLED per-pixel blacks
